02

IoT · Arduino · Assistive Tech

Smart Blind Stick — AI + IoT Navigation

Low-cost assistive stick for visually impaired users. An HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor detects obstacles within 100 cm and a buzzer works like a car parking sensor (slow → fast → continuous beeps) with vibration feedback. A NEO-6M GPS module tracks live location, and Python (Haversine formula) raises a 100 m geofence popup with a Google Maps link for caretakers.

Arduino UnoHC-SR04NEO-6M GPSPythonpyserialtkinter
View on GitHub
03

AI · Anomaly Detection · Streamlit

AI-Based CNG Leakage Early-Warning System

Research prototype testing whether multivariate anomaly detection can warn about a CNG leak earlier than a fixed gas threshold. Seed-controlled simulator, rolling/rate-of-change features, an Isolation Forest trained on normal data only, a 0–100 risk score (SAFE / WATCH / WARNING / DANGER) and a Streamlit car dashboard with a latching driver alarm. On simulated data it detected leaks in ~8.6 s vs 44.2 s for a fixed 50 ppm threshold (F1 0.947 vs 0.821) with 0 glitch false alarms. Evaluated honestly against tuned thresholds too.

Pythonscikit-learnIsolation ForestStreamlitPandasNumPy
